verdict.rationale: Paddle documents payout reconciliation reports that tie each payout to its underlying transactions and adjustments. The reports itemize gross, taxes, Paddle fees, chargeback and retained fees in both transaction and balance currencies, can be generated via API, and let you verify payout totals against remittance advice. That covers the 'see what makes up each payout' half well, but nothing in the evidence shows the user can control the payout schedule. Missing for 10: controlling the payout schedule (frequency/timing), explicit per-payout refund itemization beyond 'adjustments', independent or hands-on corroboration.
